title: Returning Borrower Terms: Application Fee Discount on a New Mortgage Loan File
content:
A customer who has already closed a Larkspur loan receives a dollar discount on the application fee of a new Mortgage Loan File. The discount is read from the date of the most recent funding wire Larkspur sent on any closing of the customer, as shown in the funding wires of the customer's Closing and Funding records (each funding wire sent, with its wire date).

**Terms.** Where that wire was sent less than 36 whole months before the collection date, 100.00 USD is taken off; where it was sent 36 or more whole months before the collection date, 50.00 USD is taken off; where Larkspur has sent no funding wire on any closing of the customer, nothing is taken off.

Only the most recent wire counts, whatever the number of earlier closings. A wire's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its wire date to the collection date, less one where the day of the month of the collection date is earlier than that of the wire date.

| Most recent funding wire sent on any closing of the customer | Whole months to the collection date (hypothetical) | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| sent 10 March, fee collected 9 March three years later | 35 | 100.00 USD |
| sent 10 March, fee collected 10 March three years later | 36 | 50.00 USD |
| two closings, wires sent nine and twelve years earlier — the most recent is nine years old | 108 | 50.00 USD |
| no funding wire sent on any closing of the customer | — | nothing |
